name: manki-aerial-double-fist
notes: Benchmark: creative text of the 2026-10-14 Manki aerial request, verbatim up to its GenRA-format HANDOFF/OUTPUT sections (the toolkit supplies the entry pose and output contract). Targets encode only constraints stated in that text.
character: Manki, experiment-time ShoulderRepair199 rig (66 joints, 10 skinned meshes)
description:
Create exactly ONE original Manki aerial double-fist downward hammer strike on the supplied approved Manki rig. The attached concept illustrates the overall attack idea: both fists drive downward together, torso folds forward, legs tuck behind/under the body, expressive tail trails. Exact hand clasp, pose proportions and appearance matching are unnecessary. Create a new attack; the explicit jump/fall examples are transition and rig references only.
AUTHORITATIVE CLOCK: use the actual existing air.4 clock only. Duration 62 ticks = 62/60 seconds; first impact at tick 23 = 23/60 seconds; active ticks 23 through 30 inclusive (exclusive end tick31); actionable recovery/IASA tick57; final key tick62. Source landing lag is12 ticks, with auto-cancel before6 and after44. Do not change these values, extend duration, or invent a new dive or jump impulse. Every timestamp must be a multiple of1/60 second, with sufficient decimal precision to round to its exact tick.
BEATS: tick0 reproduce the supplied airborne entry pose exactly. Ticks1-12 show anticipation: compact leg tuck, both closed fists lift together above/beside the head, elbows visibly bent and shoulders relaxed enough to avoid collapse. Ticks13-18 hold a clear loaded aerial silhouette, not a standing punch. Ticks19-23 sharply accelerate both fists down and somewhat forward; at tick23 both must reach a simultaneous readable downward striking silhouette below the chest, with the torso folded forward and the head tracking the strike. Ticks24-30 show a small controlled follow-through and deceleration; do not start the major recoil before the active window is complete. Ticks31-56 recoil both arms and unfold gradually back to the supplied falling pose. By tick57 reproduce that exact entry/fall pose; hold it through62.
PHYSICAL CONSTRAINTS: this is an already-airborne attack. Existing gameplay jump/fall physics owns the character trajectory. All joint translations p and scales s must remain exactly at their supplied entry values for the entire clip, including the Hips. Hips orientation, spine, arms, legs, fingers and tail may rotate. No animation root travel, added jump/dive, stepping or extra gameplay displacement. Do not translate wrists to fake a reach, stretch bones or modify the skeleton/mesh. Use rotations with plausible elbows and wrists. Both fists should be close enough to read as one coordinated double hammer strike, but keep a small gap if necessary to avoid intersections; do not force a literal interlocked clasp. Close the actual finger chains to make fists. Keep tucked feet behind the hands, with a clear asymmetric leg silhouette if useful. Use the existing five-bone tail for a modest delayed counter-motion, with no whip/twist explosion.
